answers.description: Flower shop on Otley Road with bouquets, wedding flowers and weekly arrangements for offices. Same-day delivery across north Leeds if you order before noon.

brand.name: Thistle and Fern
brand.tagline: A flower shop on Otley Road offering bouquets, wedding flowers and office blooms.

hero.headline: Bold Bouquets And Wedding Flowers In North Leeds
hero.subhead: Fresh bouquets, wedding flowers and weekly office arrangements, made on Otley Road for local customers and couples.
hero.reassurance: Just tell us what you need, we'll take care of the rest.

features.title: Flowers For Every Occasion And Every Workplace
features.lead: From birthdays to weddings to office spaces, we make flowers to suit the moment.

items.title: Bouquets For Every Occasion
items.body: Colourful bouquets made fresh on Otley Road, ready for birthdays, thank yous or just because.

items.title: Wedding Flowers
items.body: We create wedding flowers that fit your day, from bouquets to venue arrangements, all made with care.

items.title: Weekly Office Arrangements
items.body: Keep your workplace bright with fresh flowers delivered weekly, arranged to suit your office space.

steps.title: Getting Your Flowers Is Simple
steps.lead: From first message to delivery, here's how we bring your flowers to life.

items.title: Tell Us What You Need
items.body: Get in touch to share your occasion, style and budget, whether it's a bouquet or wedding flowers.

items.title: We Create Your Order
items.body: Our team puts together your flowers on Otley Road, choosing fresh blooms to match your request.

items.title: Same-Day Delivery
items.body: Order before noon and we'll deliver across north Leeds the same day, straight to your door.

copy.statement: We love bringing colour and life to north Leeds, one bouquet and one office arrangement at a time.

cta.headline: Ready To Order Your Flowers?
cta.body: Whether it's a bouquet, wedding flowers or weekly office arrangements, we're ready to help.
cta.reassurance: Just tell us your occasion, style and budget to get started.
